title: InsideEVs: This Is How Fast Tesla Cybertruck Charges From Flat To Full (State of Charge test chart)
notes: Tom Moloughney / State of Charge, 2024-05-30: a dual-motor Cybertruck (the chart title says "2024 Tesla Cybertruck Dual Motor Foundation Series"), 0-100 % at a Tesla V3 250 kW Supercharger (image https://cdn.motor1.com/images/custom/cybertruck-charging-test.jpg). Text: ~250 kW peak, ~220 at 15 %, ~125 at 50 %, ~70 at 90 %, just under 1.5 h, 122 kWh added. Researcher context, not in the article: a launch-era test, before 325 kW V4 support (2024-12).
